name: Melissa Brewer
text: I love renting WhiteWall Studio space when doing any indoor photo shoot. It’s a bit of a walk from the parking lot to the studio, but definitely worth it! I love how they have a dressing area, lighting you can rent, a Bluetooth speaker for any playlist you might want, and a stunning massive window that can create amazing, interesting shadows (depending on the weather and time of day, of course). I have rented it a couple of times now and I’m sure I’ll be using it again in the future!

name: Allison Wilson
text: As a wedding photographer who used this studio space for bridals and for my own personal branding photos for my business, I have been very pleased each time I have rented the studio! It is well equipped, clean, and the owner makes sure to give thorough instructions for arrival and departure. I will definitely be back!

name: Shawndre' Young
text: I shot a Christmas family photoshoot here and it was amazing! The decor was already beautifully set up, the space was very clean, and the hosts were incredibly helpful with quick, timely responses. Super spacious with lots of lighting and backdrop choices. Had a great time using the speaker for music, and it’s clear the owners take pride in their studio.

name: Kerrington Johnson
text: Five ⭐️! Owners were flexible, responsive, and accommodating the day of our shoot. The space was clean, well lit, and had everything we needed. Great customer service and communication.

name: Devin Orr
text: The most beautiful, thoughtfully crafted, well stocked studio ever! Will 135% be using again and again. This was my small business’s first time utilizing a studio and wow was it incredible!

name: Richard Van De Water
text: This place is the literal best. It had everything I needed for the shoots I was doing. Whether it be product photography or a lifestyle type shoot, they have you covered. And not only that but they are super easy to work with, so you know you’ll be treated well. I would recommended this space and these guys 100x over.

name: Sabrina Fields
text: Everything with WhiteWall Studios was wonderful and so convenient and simple!  They had everything I needed and even on an overcast day, I was able to capture some gorgeous photos for a shoot I was doing.  I will 100% be booking again for future sessions!

name: Tyra Rogers Balcombe
text: We had an amazing time using White Wall Studios. The space was perfect for our nutrition workshop shoot. Such a clean, bright, and inviting space. Looking forward to utilizing the space in the future!

name: Brook Sill
text: White Wall Studio was exactly what I was looking for and more. A beautiful clean open space with amazing natural light. Thorough directions for entering and using the facility. Can not recommend this studio enough!

name: Ashton Wilson
text: Absolutely loved my experience with WhiteWall Studios. It was the perfect space. It was clean, beautiful, professional, and it has absolutely everything you need to make the perfect shoot. I will definitely be using them again!

name: Caleb Guest
text: Loved getting to work in this space has great natural light but also the convenience of the overhead was amazing. Definitely gonna do some more work here

name: Neil Lopez
text: Excellent and beautiful space. I have rented here a few times and it’s always such a joy. My clients and models love the space as well.

name: Julie Brown
text: We had such a great experience with this studio for our Family photo session. It was easy to find and the studio had everything we needed and more including a dressing room and plenty of mirrors. The natural light was beautiful and there was plenty of space for a group of 15 people to move around and configure/reconfigure. We will definitely use it again.

name: Jamie Medeiros
text: Super cute and clean space. Perfect for photos. We will be back again!

name: Leah Morgan
text: I cannot say enough good things about WhiteWall Studios. The space is CHEF’S KISS. The props and additional lighting or backdrop booking add ons make your day even easier. Whitewall studios is the only way to go for any creative need in the upstate!

name: Corey Messer
text: It's a great space. The folks who came up with this concept really thought about everything. We loved it.

name: Becca Wise
text: I work for a nonprofit that recently booked WhiteWall for a brand shoot, and we had the best time! Cute + clean space, and management was extremely generous upon learning we were a nonprofit. We will definitely be booking again!

name: Matthew LaPenna
text: This has been probably one of the best experiences renting a studio I have ever had! The team at Whitewall have been so good to work with. We rented the studio for 2 days. Plenty of space. Super clean and organized. The natural light is absolutely amazing. I would easily rent this space again and intend on doing so.

name: Harrison Easler
text: The owner was SO nice and understanding when we requested more time for our shoot. Everything was so clean and pretty. They even had their Christmas props ready for use! We were able to get some super cute headshots and creative shots. I would definitely book here again. Thanks WhiteWall! It was a blast!

name: Jake Agresti
text: Great experience! If you are looking for a studio to get some great quality pictures, please consider WhiteWall Studios. I used this venue for professional photos and family photos. My photographer was raving about how the light is great, and it was hard to take a bad picture. After seeing our photos, we would agree! Highly recommend and will use again. (Photo credit @mckenziemariephoto)

name: Hannah Decossas
text: Fantastic studio space with great natural light! They have an awesome light kit you can rent, and so many props for you to use. The owners have thought of everything + the process from booking, to getting to and using the studio are seamless and so easy! I highly recommend it!

name: bailey black
text: WhiteWall Studios is hands down one of the most beautiful, clean, and spacious studios I've shot at. I shot there for my first time and I am so eager to go back. The massive windows make for beautiful natural lighting, and even have some fun shadows to play with. So much room to create!

name: Kensley Pringle
text: I loved the simplicity of utilizing the studio. Accessing the studio was super user friendly. The place is spacious, airy, and provides lots of natural, bright light. The communication is spot on - lots of professionalism. I loved the videos they provide for visual learners on accessing, navigating, and closing down the studio!

name: Kelsey Joy
text: Both my clients and I truly enjoyed our time at WhiteWall Studios! They responded to my questions in a super timely manner, had detailed instructions in using the space, and the space was spotless! The space is awe-inspiring and I can't wait to be back again soon.

name: Blasé Blaze
text: Yo WhiteWall is dope! They got just about everything you need for photoshoots and video shoots. It's easy to book. And they give clear instructions on what to do after you book. Me and my crew actually went over our time and the owner contacted us. After immediately gathering our things, he sent a be safe text for the ride home. He was more concerned about us verses us going over our time. I'm not saying to do that though. Just highlighting their hospitality. We will be using them again in the near future.

name: Anna Bullock
text: Whitewall Studios is always a go-to for me for clients looking for a bright, clean, and natural light focused space. It might be a little complicated to explain where it is to clients but the Studio sends  very clear video walkthroughs and explanations of how to find the space after you book. 10/10.

name: Lens Flare Photography
text:
Great studio space.. Definitely a five star review, but I think a Roomba would be good fit for the studio..
Not a fan of the black curtains, but if they were long to the floor, I could see that being a bit more helpful.. Great customer service. And I think the price was right on point.

name: karina viznyak
text:
I was  giving whitewall studios 2 stars because of how hot it is inside the studio, we rented it out to take our family photos and it was a sauna in there we turned on the fans as well as the tiny little ac unit that didn’t do a thing, we had a little newborn baby with us and it was just too hot we ended up needing to leave because of how hot it was so if you are planning to take photos here be prepared to break a sweat and bring some ice cold water, not to mention the  photos didn’t turn out the way we would have liked them to everyone looked exhausted and sweaty, so I don’t recommend renting here in the summer at all unless they fix the problem by investing into a bigger ac unit that can actually cool off the room. Overall nice studio, but the place it self is sketchy.. here’s my honest review, we rented it out in July 2022.

Whitewall Studios reached back out and resolved the issue with us personally! We will come back and rent again in the future for the kind response and great customer service !

name: danielle dziedzic
text: I love White Wall Studios! They have such a nice spot to work as a photographer and videographer as well as being photographed for our website. Their space offers so many different setups and just a variety of different scenes can be accomplished here. The lighting is phenomenal and the location of the studio is great!! Easy parking and access!

name: Elias Falero
text: I was blown away by the level of professionalism from the team at Whitewall. From the Amazing overhead lights, furniture options, and different colored backdrops, to the attention to detail. I especially loved the easy accessibility and the instructional video that you receive upon booking that shows how to find and access the space. Thank you guys for an amazing experience!

name: Kayla Kirk
text: Wonderful experience. Beautiful, natural light studio. They made the process easy and I'm excited for an opportunity to use this space again!

name: Varnessa Bails
text: The space is absolutely beautiful and it was the perfect set up for my boutique! I love the ease of booking and the amazing and quick response of the owner(s). Definitely considering a monthly package!

name: Jennifer Schultz
text: We loved everything about our session at Whitewall Studios! Everything was seamless and we will definitely use this space again!

name: Sarah Konklin
text:
WhiteWall Studios was amazing to work with! First off, their communication and professionalism was unparalled. Secondly, their space is PERFECT. I rented out the space for my business and it was just what we were looking for.

10/10 recommend!

name: Mitchy Gleed
text: The studio is incredible. It was a great space for a versatile session. The extra backgrounds were well worth adding onto my booking. The couches and extra tools were in great condition and easy to use.

name: Shannon Corbitt
text: Amazing aesthetic + great owners to work with. Very user friendly concept and versatile space. This place was perfect for the photoshoot I had in mind. Great location with Farehouse right next door, we went for dinner right after our two hour session window.

name: Sydney Rose Portraits LLC
text: It's one of my favorite studios in and around the Greenville area! The space is always super clean, easy to book, and gorgeous for all kinds of sessions.

name: Jordan Wheeler
text: Took some bridals here and thought I can't post results yet, they turned out incredibly. The space was clean, quiet, and full of ample nature light and possibilities! I plan to come here often to shoot:)

name: Kendall Kiersnowski
text: Hands down the best studio in Greenville. Couldn't recommend enough! The lighting is beautiful and White Wall is very professional in all aspects of the studio. Look forward to shooting here again!

name: Reagan Gillespie
text: White Wall Studios was fantastic! Their instructions were super clear and easy to follow. It was a beautiful and very clean!

name: Ally Smith (Ally Smith Photography)
text: Absolutely love this studio! They have such an amazing setup and I love that you can have time for you and your client without the third person! Will def be booking again!

name: Heath Shaver
text: Convenient, clean, well maintained. Couldn’t ask for a better studio in Greenville

name: Marshall Powell
text: Beautiful space, easy to access, and very clear instructions.

name: Eliza Ellett
text: Space is absolutely BEAUTIFUL! Felt like a dream shooting in such amazing natural light. Have already booked another shoot here and will be back many more times.

name: Grace Mason
text: Absolutely LOVE whitewall studio! It’s always clean and beautiful. Definitely my favorite studio to use for photography! Would recommend 10/10!

name: Mary Ashleigh Browning
text: WhiteWall Studios was perfect! The instructions for easy access + use, plus everything you're provided with was great. I will definitely be back in the future!

name: Katie Lee
text: Seriously the BEST place to shoot in!! Clean, amazing props, and the friendliest most helpful owners! All my shoots I’ve done here have turned out beautifully

name: Sierra Collins
text: The studio was perfect for my client's minimalistic gender reveal. I'd definitely book again!

name: Katie Owens
text: Our Creative team had a shoot here for our spring line and our content turned out soo good! They have everything you need and make it so easy for you to just show up and start snapping away!

name: Teddy Giard
text: Was an awesome space. Endless amount of opportunity for seriously ANY photography/videography needs.

name: Anna Duncan
text: Can't recommend this space enough. The communication and customer service are great, and the studio is stunning. Can't wait to shoot here again soon!

name: Samantha Davis
text: Very clean easy access and had everything you need for a photoshoot! Can’t wait to come back and shoot more

name: Stacy Burton
text: loved using this studio....perfect natural light, perfect aesthetic for black and white images

name: Ashley Kickasola
text: WhiteWall NEVER disappoints. The studio is always immaculate and I’ve never had a client upset with their photos!

name: Emily Gilmer
text: A beautiful studio with so much room for creativity. I will definitely be booking again and will recommend Whitewall Studio to everyone!

name: Joey Pelicano
text: Absolutely gorgeous space. Had everything I needed and more. The location was awesome. I will certainly be shooting here again.

name: Leslie Franklin
text: Such a amazing space and has everything a photographer needs!! Very accommodating on booking times and easy access!!
